text.allergic.config.title: Allergic settings
option.allergic.allergyChance.tooltip: Chance for each edible item to become an allergen. 0.35 means 35%.
option.allergic.allergyDurationSeconds.t: How long the allergy lasts after eating an allergen.
option.allergic.tearingBlurStrength.tool: Controls how strongly Tearing blurs the world. 0 disables blur; 10 is the strongest.
option.allergic.sneezingEnabled.tooltip: Enables sneeze sounds, particles, and the sneeze overlay.
option.allergic.sneezeDamageEnabled.tool: Makes sneezing damage the affected entity.
option.allergic.sneezeMaxIntervalSeconds: Longest delay between sneezes. Must be at least the minimum.
option.allergic.sneezeDamageAmount.toolt: Damage from one sneeze before effect-level scaling.
option.allergic.nauseaEnabled.tooltip: Periodically applies the vanilla Nausea effect.
option.allergic.nauseaMaxIntervalSeconds: Longest delay between nausea episodes. Must be at least the minimum.
option.allergic.nauseaDurationSeconds.to: How long each nausea episode lasts.
option.allergic.weaknessEnabled.tooltip: Applies the vanilla Weakness effect for the allergy duration.
option.allergic.slownessEnabled.tooltip: Applies the vanilla Slowness effect for the allergy duration.
option.allergic.miningFatigueEnabled.too: Applies the vanilla Mining Fatigue effect for the allergy duration.
commands.allergic.regenerated: Regenerated %s food allergens using the current configuration.
